tests.name: Login & Session Configuration Audit
tests.description: Verifies lockout policies, session fixation defenses, and credential transmission boundaries.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because authentication route /api/v1/auth/login was discovered during footprinting.

tests.name: JWT & Session Token Integrity Inspection
tests.description: Analyzes JWT signing algorithm, expiration enforcement, and weak HMAC secret patterns.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because JWT Bearer token technology was identified in target profile.

tests.name: Session Revocation on Logout & State Guard
tests.description: Checks server-side session invalidation on credential update or logout.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected to verify server-side invalidation for discovered stateful session tokens.

tests.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Enforcement
tests.description: Tests whether restricted administrative console routes reject unprivileged user tokens.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because administrative interface route /admin was discovered.

tests.name: IDOR / BOLA Endpoint Object Reference Guard
tests.description: Tests if User A can read or mutate private profile details belonging to User B by altering the resource ID.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because parameterized object resource /api/v1/users/:id was identified.

tests.name: Vertical Privilege Escalation Boundary Check
tests.description: Tests if client-supplied role parameters (e.g. role="admin") are rejected during profile update.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because parameter 'role' was discovered in user modification endpoint.

tests.name: API Route Authentication & Token Enforcement
tests.description: Validates that unauthenticated requests to telemetry endpoints are strictly rejected with 401 Unauthorized.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because 8 REST API endpoints were discovered requiring endpoint guard verification.

tests.name: Excessive Data Exposure & Sensitive Fields in JSON DTO
tests.description: Inspects API responses for leaked password hashes, internal server paths, or internal metadata.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because user directory route /api/v1/users returns structured JSON objects.

tests.name: HTTP Method Override & CORS Wildcard Policy
tests.description: Audits CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers for wildcard (*) reflection and unauthorized HTTP verbs.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because OPTIONS and cross-origin preflight routes were discovered.

tests.name: API Rate-Limiting & Burst Request Throttling
tests.description: Tests whether repeated login or API queries trigger HTTP 429 Too Many Requests rate-limiting.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because high-volume endpoint /api/v1/auth/login requires denial-of-service throttling.

tests.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Sanitization Indicators
tests.description: Evaluates if reflected user inputs or dangerouslySetInnerHTML bindings sanitize HTML/script entities.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because user profile input forms and parameter fields (username, email, password) were discovered.

tests.name: SQL & Query Injection Parameter Probes
tests.description: Checks for structured query parsing errors or raw string concatenation indicators in database queries.
tests.reasonForSelection: Selected because query filter parameters ('search', 'filter') accept structured input.

tests.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Redirection Probes
tests.description: Tests if server-side URL fetching accepts localhost, internal loopback, or cloud metadata IP addresses.

tests.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) & Clickjacking Defenses

tests.name: Client-Side Hardcoded Secrets & Configuration Hygiene
tests.description: Inspects client script modules and public configs for embedded API private keys or access tokens.

tests.name: Sensitive LocalStorage & SessionStorage Usage
tests.description: Audits browser storage mechanisms for persistent storage of unencrypted bearer tokens or user PII.

tests.name: HTTPS Enforcement & HSTS Header Configuration
tests.description: Verifies automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect and HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) headers.

tests.name: Insecure Cleartext Transport Channel Audit

tests.name: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) Leakage

finding.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) in User Endpoint
finding.description: Tests if User A can read or mutate private profile details belonging to User B by altering the resource ID.
finding.businessImpact: Potential compromise of authorization security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
finding.technicalImpact: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
finding.reproductionSteps:
1. Authenticate as regular user A.
2. Send GET request to /api/v1/users/usr_98241.
3. Observe 200 OK response returning profile and balance of user B without authorization check.

remediation.problem: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated idor / bola endpoint object reference guard breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Implement server-side object authorization checks verifying session ownership for every requested resource ID.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat IDOR / BOLA Endpoint Object Reference Guard using authorized test credentials.

evidence.observation: Security test TEST-AUTHZ-002 observed policy violation at endpoint /api/v1/users/:id.

finding.title: Excessive Data Exposure in User Directory API Response
finding.description: Inspects API responses for leaked password hashes, internal server paths, or internal metadata.
finding.businessImpact: Potential compromise of api security security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
finding.technicalImpact: API endpoint exposes sensitive internal fields (password hash, internal role token) that should not be transmitted to client scope.
finding.reproductionSteps:
1. Send authenticated GET request to /api/v1/users?limit=1.
2. Parse JSON response object.
3. Confirm presence of passwordHash and internalServerRoute fields.

remediation.problem: API endpoint exposes sensitive internal fields (password hash, internal role token) that should not be transmitted to client scope.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated excessive data exposure & sensitive fields in json dto breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Employ strict Data Transfer Objects (DTO) with field serialization allowlists to filter out sensitive backend fields.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat Excessive Data Exposure & Sensitive Fields in JSON DTO using authorized test credentials.

finding.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP) & Clickjacking Defenses
finding.description: Audits presence and strictness of Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options headers.
finding.businessImpact: Potential compromise of client security security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
finding.technicalImpact: Server does not return Content-Security-Policy or X-Frame-Options headers, leaving the application vulnerable to frame embedding and script injection.
finding.reproductionSteps:
1. Send HTTP GET request to web landing page /.
2. Inspect response headers.
3. Confirm absence of Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options.

remediation.problem: Server does not return Content-Security-Policy or X-Frame-Options headers, leaving the application vulnerable to frame embedding and script injection.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated content security policy (csp) & clickjacking defenses breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Configure web server / reverse proxy to include Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self' and X-Frame-Options: DENY.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat Content Security Policy (CSP) & Clickjacking Defenses using authorized test credentials.

evidence.observation: Security test TEST-CLIENT-001 observed policy violation at endpoint /.

testExecutions.reasonForSelection: Selected because client configuration route /api/v1/config/client delivers JSON runtime configuration.

finding.title: Client-Accessible Environment Secret Exposure
finding.description: Inspects client script modules and public configs for embedded API private keys or access tokens.
finding.businessImpact: Potential compromise of client security security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
finding.technicalImpact: Client runtime configuration endpoint returns private API secret keys in public JSON response.
finding.reproductionSteps:
1. Send GET request to /api/v1/config/client.
2. Inspect returned JSON.
3. Observe private serviceSecretKey field delivered in public client scope.

remediation.problem: Client runtime configuration endpoint returns private API secret keys in public JSON response.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated client-side hardcoded secrets & configuration hygiene breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Isolate private API keys on backend services and invoke external services via authenticated proxy endpoints.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat Client-Side Hardcoded Secrets & Configuration Hygiene using authorized test credentials.

evidence.observation: Security test TEST-CLIENT-002 observed policy violation at endpoint /api/v1/config/client.

finding.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Header
finding.description: Verifies automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect and HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) headers.
finding.businessImpact: Potential compromise of secure communication security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
finding.technicalImpact: Application does not enforce TLS upgrade header Strict-Transport-Security, permitting downgrade attacks over insecure networks.
finding.reproductionSteps:
1. Request target root URL / via HTTPS.
2. Examine response headers for Strict-Transport-Security.
3. Header is absent.

remediation.problem: Application does not enforce TLS upgrade header Strict-Transport-Security, permitting downgrade attacks over insecure networks.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated https enforcement & hsts header configuration breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload to all HTTPS responses.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat HTTPS Enforcement & HSTS Header Configuration using authorized test credentials.

remediation.problem: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated idor / bola endpoint object reference guard breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Implement server-side object authorization checks verifying session ownership for every requested resource ID.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat IDOR / BOLA Endpoint Object Reference Guard using authorized test credentials.

finding.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) in User Endpoint
finding.description: Tests if User A can read or mutate private profile details belonging to User B by altering the resource ID.
finding.businessImpact: Potential compromise of authorization security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
finding.technicalImpact: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
finding.reproductionSteps:
1. Authenticate as regular user A.
2. Send GET request to /api/v1/users/usr_98241.
3. Observe 200 OK response returning profile and balance of user B without authorization check.

remediation.problem: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated idor / bola endpoint object reference guard breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Implement server-side object authorization checks verifying session ownership for every requested resource ID.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat IDOR / BOLA Endpoint Object Reference Guard using authorized test credentials.

findings.businessImpact: Potential compromise of client security security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
findings.technicalImpact: Client runtime configuration endpoint returns private API secret keys in public JSON response.

remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat Client-Side Hardcoded Secrets & Configuration Hygiene using authorized test credentials.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) in User Endpoint
findings.description: Tests if User A can read or mutate private profile details belonging to User B by altering the resource ID.
findings.businessImpact: Potential compromise of authorization security boundaries leading to unauthorized data disclosure.
findings.technicalImpact: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
findings.reproductionSteps:
1. Authenticate as regular user A.
2. Send GET request to /api/v1/users/usr_98241.
3. Observe 200 OK response returning profile and balance of user B without authorization check.

remediation.problem: Server does not properly verify ownership of the requested user record. Authenticated user A was able to access account record of user B.
remediation.whyItMatters: Unmitigated idor / bola endpoint object reference guard breaches key confidentiality and access control assumptions.
remediation.recommendedFix: Implement server-side object authorization checks verifying session ownership for every requested resource ID.
remediation.verificationMethod: Repeat IDOR / BOLA Endpoint Object Reference Guard using authorized test credentials.

evidence.title: Evidence: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Header
evidence.observation: Security test TEST-TRANS-001 observed policy violation at endpoint /.

validationResult.expectedBehavior: Endpoint must enforce strict validation, authorization, and cryptographic boundaries.
